title: SCHC rule for MQTT-SN port 10883
notes: Implemented Zephyr/C SCHC Rule 7 for MQTT-SN UDP 10883 in the clean SCHC subsystem. Added deterministic rule selection, canonical fe80::/64 versus full-address residues, source/destination/both-port direction encoding, strict IPv6/UDP checksum and length validation, address policy enforcement, zero padding/canonical decode checks, 22554-byte fragmentation-profile ceiling, length/checksum reconstruction, and RFC 768 zero-checksum serialization as 0xffff. Added standalone focused C vector tests covering all six canonical shared vectors, malformed/truncated/noncanonical/address/checksum/unknown-port/buffer cases, and exact/over profile size boundary. Validation: CMake host build + ctest PASS 1/1 under UBSan; cppcheck warning/performance/portability PASS; python uv pytest -q tests/schc/test_headers.py -k mqtt_sn PASS 11. Rust codec.rs Rule 7 implementation and shared vectors were inspected as controlling parity oracle; exact cargo rerun was blocked on a shared artifact-directory lock held by concurrent repository work and was cancelled without disturbing it.
close_reason: Implemented and validated Zephyr SCHC MQTT-SN Rule 7 against canonical cross-language vectors
